t.Conta (nome, telefone, senha), a busca u: Account (name, phone, password), the search used to measure your position in the area, read-only data from Google, the plan and the LGPD channel. It could be native because the backend came first: `api/conta.js` reads and writes the person's data — something no endpoint in the project did, which is why these fields were just for show in the current dashboard, with buttons that did nothing.

t.canal do titular, Art. 18 da LGPD: data subject channel, Art. 18 of the LGPD

t.A senha atual é exigida na troca — o tok: The current password is required to change it — the token protects against strangers on the internet, the current password protects against whoever is in front of the merchant's unlocked phone
t.Trocar o e-mail de login: hoje remete à: Changing the login email: today it points to the help center. Touching this requires confirming the new address BEFORE switching, otherwise a typo locks the account out
t.O cancelamento IMEDIATO (limitação do Me: IMMEDIATE cancellation (a Mercado Pago limitation) ended on 09/07/2026: in Stripe, “until the end of the paid period” is native (cancel_at_period_end), and that's how the backend already responds
t.Já existe: central de ajuda e suporte po: Already exists: help center and WhatsApp support
t.Na casca nova ganha um lugar fixo na nav: In the new shell it gets a fixed spot in the navigation instead of living only in the floating button.
t.Sistema completo pra negócios brasileiro: Complete system for local businesses to manage their Google reputation, 100% within the rules.
t.A confirmação não bate com a nova senha: The confirmation doesn't match the new password
t.Categoria salva no seu perfil · sincroni: Category saved to your profile · syncs across all devices. Reloading…
t.Voltando pra categoria automática do Goo: Switching back to Google's automatic category…
t.O dispositivo StarTouch abre o seu menu: The StarTouch device opens your menu instantly. Building it is free; to publish, 7 days free, no card needed.
t.O dado é do lojista; a StarTouch trata p: The data belongs to the merchant; StarTouch processes it on their behalf
t.NÃO existe “taxa de conversão”: toque →: There is NO “conversion rate”: tap → click we measure; tap → published review Google doesn't report back
t.O nome saiu do caminho; o escopo ainda n: The name is out of the way; the scope isn't yet
t.nome, telefone e troca de senha sem sair: name, phone and password change without leaving the dashboard
t.O que a rede consolidada soma e o que el: What the consolidated network adds up and what it does NOT. Taps add up; the Google rating doesn't, because an average of averages isn't an average — it must be weighted by number of reviews, or it isn't shown
t.O que é da PESSOA se edita aqui; o que é: What belongs to the PERSON is edited here; what belongs to the BUSINESS comes from Google and is read-only — an editable field that changes nothing is the easiest lie a dashboard can tell
